notes: Single-attestation root: the entire corpus has exactly one occurrence of this root (Job.32.6, זָחַלְתִּי, "I was afraid"), supporting the "fear" sense specifically -- "crawl" isn't independently attested, but is kept as descriptive elaboration of the same lexical entry rather than a separately-sourced sense.

Trimmed "crawl; shrink back; fear" to "shrink back; fear" per the compound-gloss trim audit: the root's single attestation (Job.32.6, "I was afraid") supports "fear" and, closely, "shrink back" (shrinking back in fear); it does not show the literal, physically distinct sense "crawl".

Trimmed "shrink back; fear" further to "fear": the root's single attestation (Job.32.6, "I was afraid") supports one evidenced state; "shrink back" was a synonym description of the same fear, not a second, distinct sense.
